morphology.pattern_note: ber- 接 balas 时保留原形，不发生鼻音同化；词义随语境分为回应、得到回应及相互回应。

senses.zh_definition: 回答；应声，尤指声音回应先前的呼唤。
senses.en_definition: To answer or call back, especially in response to a voice.
senses.nuances: 此义带叙事或文学色彩。日常表达“回复某人的信息”通常用 membalas mesej；berbalas mesej 则强调双方来回交流。

collocations.en: to answer from inside the house

senses.zh_definition: 得到回答、回应或同等感情的回报。
senses.en_definition: To be answered, returned, or reciprocated.
senses.nuances: 常见于 cinta tidak berbalas，表示爱情未获回应；此处主语是得到回应的感情或行为，并非作出回应的人。

senses.zh_definition: 双方或多方轮流回应；互相交换话语、信息或班顿诗。
senses.en_definition: To exchange responses or take turns replying to one another.
senses.ms_definition: Balas-berbalas; saling membalas antara satu sama lain.
senses.nuances: 强调互动的往返性。berbalas pantun 指以班顿诗相互应答；berbalas mesej 指互发信息，不能据此判断交流是否友好。

dual_scenarios.en: Participants exchanged pantun verses at the cultural event organised by the school.

dual_scenarios.en: Have you two started messaging each other?

etymology.historical_story: Balas belongs to an inherited Austronesian word family connecting answering with repayment and retaliation. The comparative record includes Malay balas and Javanese wales, illustrating how returning words and returning actions share a semantic foundation. Berbalas expresses this relationship through answering, receiving a response, or exchanging responses. Source: [Austronesian Comparative Dictionary](https://acd.clld.org/cognatesets/25053).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 balas“回”：声音回过来是应答，爱意回过来是回应，消息来回就是 berbalas mesej。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 互答班顿诗时，即使带有调侃，也宜注意对方身份和场合，避免让人难堪。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于诗歌应答、信息往来及感情回应。谈论别人的 cinta tidak berbalas 涉及私事，宜避免公开取笑或追问。
